description:
Add a new provincial billing service code to the OSCAR EMR fee schedule. The Ministry has released a new temporary code for 'Telephone Consultation (Mental Health)'. 

Log in as 'oscardoc' (Password: 'oscar', PIN: '1117'). Navigate to the Administration panel, locate the Billing/Service Code management section, and add the new code.

Details to enter:
- Service Code: K083
- Description: Telephone Consultation (Mental Health)
- Unit Price (Fee): 45.00
- Status: Active

Ensure the code is saved and available for billing.
